title: Diyanet Vakfı meali, earlier ungrouped e-text (circulates online also as "Adem Uğur")
author: Ali Özek, Hayreddin Karaman, Ali Turgut, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadreddin Gümüş (TDV committee)
translator: Ali Özek, Hayreddin Karaman, Ali Turgut, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadreddin Gümüş (TDV committee)
edition: tanzil tr.vakfi ("Diyanet Vakfı"); per-ayah text without the official verse groups
licence: tanzil.net translation terms: non-commercial use, verbatim, cite tanzil.net; rights remain with translator/publisher; local research copy only.
notes: Identity: wording equals the official grouped TDV meal (kd ML=4) wherever that meal does not group (1:5, 1:7, 93:7) and shows an earlier revision elsewhere (22:46 "(Sana karşı çıkanlar)" vs kd "(Seni yalanlayanlar)"). The same e-text is labelled "Adem Uğur" on mealler.org and fawazahmed0 (tur-ademugur); no evidence was found that it is a separate Adem Uğur translation, so the label is treated as a misattribution of the TDV text (host label kept here for the record). 10 merged verse groups stored once as a..a_end. Cross-check over S1, S22, S87-114 (primary tanzil.net tr.vakfi) - mealler.org "Adem Uğur": n=373, exact 71.8%, loose 94.1%, sim 0.988; â/î/û in 20.9% of ayat (primary 0.5%); bracket counts differ in 5 ayat (e.g. 1:1, 87:1, 87:5); most divergent 113:4 (sim 0.29) | fawazahmed0/quran-api tur-diyanetvakfi: n=373, exact 1.3%, loose 99.7%, sim 1.0; â/î/û in 0.5% of ayat (primary 0.5%); bracket counts differ in 1 ayat (e.g. 104:3); most divergent 104:3 (sim 0.98) | fawazahmed0/quran-api tur-ademugur: n=373, exact 0.8%, loose 94.4%, sim 0.991; â/î/û in 20.9% of ayat (primary 0.5%); bracket counts differ in 6 ayat (e.g. 1:1, 87:1, 87:5); most divergent 101:1 (sim 0.43).

worst.primary: Ve düğümlere üfürüp büyü yapan üfürükçülerin şerrinden,
worst.other: De ki: 'Yaratıkların şerrinden, bastırdığı zaman karanlığın şerrinden, düğümlere nefes eden büyücülerin şerrinden, hased ettiği zaman hasedcilerin şerrinden, ta
Evet, siz de benim taptığıma tapıyor değilsiniz
